summary: A public LinkedIn article under Pedro Lima's byline explains how to check startup credit offers against the providers' current terms, using three dated Sourcey records and direct vendor pages.
account_creation_date_precision: month, as displayed by LinkedIn's About this profile panel

observations.fact: AWS Activate Founders starts with $1,000 in credits and selected participants can receive up to $5,000.
observations.quoted_value: Up to $5,000 in AWS credits for selected Founders participants

observations.fact: Google Cloud Start offers up to $2,000 in credits for one year to eligible startups founded within the last 24 months.
observations.quoted_value: Up to $2,000 in Google Cloud credits for one year

observations.fact: DigitalOcean Startups lists 12 months of variable cloud credits and 15 months of Standard-tier support.
observations.quoted_value: 12 months of cloud credits (amount varies) + 15 months free Standard-tier support
